description: Search memories of previous work by keywords/question. Returns facts, decisions, tasks and fixed errors. Call at session start!

maxChars.description: Optional — cut the result at N characters to fit the context window

mode.description: "index" = one line per hit with id; get details with get_memory

project.description: Optional — limit to one project (path or name)

query.description: Question or keywords, e.g. "why did the build fail"

name: recall
